dishes.name: Amiens macaron
dishes.desc: A soft, chewy almond and honey cake, nothing like the Parisian meringue sandwich. Baked in Amiens since the Renaissance and sold in local patisseries.

dishes.name: Ficelle picarde
dishes.desc: A savoury crêpe rolled around ham and mushrooms, topped with cream and cheese and baked golden. A Picardy classic created in Amiens in the 1950s.

dishes.name: Amiens duck pâté
dishes.desc: Duck and pork baked in a pastry crust, served cold in slices. Made in Amiens since the 19th century.

dishes.name: Flamiche
dishes.desc: A leek and cream tart, the Picardy answer to quiche. A staple starter in Amiens and across the Somme.

dishes.name: Gâteau battu
dishes.desc: A tall, airy egg brioche from Picardy, baked in a tin and eaten for breakfast or with coffee in Amiens bakeries.
